design_philosophy: E1 Protocol: Emotional trust first. Tax compliance for Filipino freelancers is an anxious, high-friction process. We use an 'Organic & Earthy' palette (warm sand, deep olive, soft sage) to evoke calm, stability, and professional control. No 'fintech bro' dark mode. No boring enterprise gray. The design must feel like stepping into a well-lit, premium accounting consultant's office.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-bold text-olive-900
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-bold text-olive-900
scale.h3: text-xl sm:text-2xl tracking-tight leading-snug font-semibold text-olive-800

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing. Use 2-3x more spacing than standard designs. Containers with borders MUST have heavy internal padding (p-6, p-8) to prevent text collision.

marketing_page.hero_overlay: bg-white/20 to bg-white/40 (gradient overlay for contrast, never flat black blanket)

dashboard_page.density: Tight but highly readable. Utilize h-full on children for strict optical alignment.

surface_strategies.cards_and_widgets: Neumorphism (Tactile Variant) - Clay & Crisp. Flat background matching parent exactly or slightly elevated paper (#FFFFFF). Soft ambient shadow + 1px sharp inner border (border-sand-200) to ground it.
surface_strategies.headers_and_nav: If content scrolls under, use Crystal Glass: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-sand-200. If solid, use bg-sand-50 border-b border-sand-200.
surface_strategies.footers: Massive Space: py-24 bg-olive-900 text-sand-50. Contrast shift from light body to dark footer.

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Calm and responsive. Micro-interactions for feedback, avoiding excessive bounce.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. e.g., hover:bg-olive-900 hover:text-white
motion_and_interactions.focus_states: High contrast ring: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-terracotta-500 focus:outline-none
motion_and_interactions.transitions: transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out (specific properties: transform, opacity, background-color, border-color)

buttons.primary: bg-olive-900 text-white hover:bg-olive-800 rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-sand-100 text-olive-900 border border-sand-300 hover:bg-sand-200 rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.accent: bg-terracotta-600 text-white hover:bg-terracotta-700 rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm

components.forms: Shadcn Form primitives deeply customized. Input fields must have solid light backgrounds (bg-white), 1px border-sand-300, rounded-md, p-3. Labels must be text-sm font-semibold text-olive-900.
components.badges: rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold tracking-wide. For tax status: bg-sage-100 text-olive-900.
components.charts: Shadcn charts using recharts. Colors must map to Olive, Terracotta, and Sage to avoid default blue/teal palettes.

accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='generate-bir-form-button').
accessibility.contrast: Text must meet minimum 4.5:1 ratio against backgrounds. Use text-olive-900 on sand backgrounds. Do not use generic #808080 gray.

images.description: Solo professional working on a laptop in a bright, minimalist home office. Use for Hero Section to build immediate empathy and aspiration.
Freelancer working outside/at a cafe. Use for Testimonial or 'Work from anywhere' feature block.
Subtle paper texture. Use as a blended background layer (opacity 5-10%) on the landing page to give a high-end editorial feel.
Female doctor/professional. Use in the audience-targeting section ('Built for Doctors, Lawyers, Consultants').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and setup the required fonts (Cabinet Grotesk and Manrope) in the global CSS.
Apply the Warm Sand (#F9F8F6) background globally to the body.
Implement the landing page using the Tetris Grid logic. Avoid standard boring columns. Overlap images with content boxes slightly.
For the BIR form generator, use a multi-step wizard (Shadcn Tabs/Forms) with clear, large typography. Make the inputs feel physical and premium.
Dashboard should utilize the 'Control Room' grid: dense, gap-6, 1px borders, avoiding heavy shadows or generic card looks. Use pure white for data containers on top of the sand background.
Ensure the hero image has a gentle gradient overlay (bg-white/30) to ensure text legibility.
Never use generic teal or purple.
Add 'data-testid' to EVERY button, input, and interactive link.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a premium, consistent iconography style across the app.
Build the dashboard routing: Dashboard (Deadlines), Filing History, Form Generator, AI Tax Assistant, and Admin.
